name: Does AKN Design Group offer smoke damage restoration services?

mainEntity.name: Does AKN Design Group offer smoke damage restoration services?

acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group specializes in comprehensive residential remodeling, including luxury kitchens, spa-inspired bathrooms, whole-home remodels, and additions. While we excel at rebuilding and renovating homes after significant events, our primary focus is on planned, customized design-build projects rather than emergency restoration or initial cleanup services for smoke damage. For direct smoke damage mitigation and cleanup, we recommend contacting a specialized restoration company first.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group focuses on residential design-build remodels, not emergency smoke damage cleanup or restoration. We recommend a specialized restoration company for initial mitigation.
